purpose: Assess possible missed structures using mild detector perturbations and unseeded raw-supported weak lines. Do not alter the frozen detector mask.

group_policy.only_rim_or_speckles: Record sensitivity; do not call them true defects

limits: These are initial engineering values, not calibrated confidence thresholds
Parameter stability cannot establish correctness; the immutable8/20 anchor creates high overlap by construction
Record new and lost pixels: nonlinear postprocessing is not necessarily monotone
Same scene's directions/exposures are supporting observations, not independent test samples
A single direction may reveal a true scratch; multiple directions increase evidence but are not mandatory
Continuous unseeded evidence is review-only, never merged into detector output
All23 groups are development data from three physical boards;007-010 excluded
Manual004 path loaded only after predictions and used as a development case check, not validation accuracy
No complete background truth, no FPR/recall/calibrated probability
TJ existing model not executed or overwritten
No FPGA work, captures, bit programming or external messages
